title: Owner-cropped early-game Lumiose overview sources
source_policy: Exact owner JPEG bytes. No metadata added, recrop, resampling, retouching, or replacement of earlier assets.
fit_policy: Approximate translation from multiscale high-pass cross-correlation, then local normalized patch matches and a least-squares affine fit. Training and holdouts selected from alternating source grid cells. Holdout residuals are image-pixel agreement with the Atlas basemap, not surveyed position accuracy.
limitations: Early-game map UI, icons and player cursor are not position evidence. No new fixed markers, sector/Wild Zone boundaries, floor geometry, or routes.

Do not infer missing/unlocked zones or a complete verified area from coverage. Pixel error varies spatially; 12.5 px maximum held-out residual. Review independently named map landmarks around each area before production use.
No change to live basemap, player paths, stored progress, feedback or original Workspace site.
